question: What request does the beloved make to Īśāna regarding the essential truth of the heart?
premises: The speaker claims to be beloved of Īśāna.
The speaker asks Īśāna to reveal the heart-truth.
inference: The beloved requests disclosure of the heart-truth from Īśāna.
plain_english: O Īśāna, if I am beloved to you, tell me the truth of the heart.
